blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals damage, you gain that much life.

needs.what: a trigger event 'deals_damage' whose subject is the dealing permanent and which fires on every DAMAGE_DEALT from that source -- combat or noncombat, to a player, a planeswalker or a creature -- binding the amount dealt so the effect can read 'that much'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: deals_combat_damage covers combat damage only; deals_damage_to_player covers only the player half of DAMAGE_DEALT (EVENT_HALVES), so noncombat damage to a creature (e.g. a fight) is missed; dealt_damage is the victim's side (enrage). Lifelink is a static, not a trigger, and differs in rules (it is not a triggered ability on the stack), so it would be an approximation
